newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER- POLAND V ITALY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER- POLAND V ITALY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's World Cup European group two qualifier between Poland and Italy:

Poland: 1-Andrzej Wozniak; 2-Pawel Skrzypek, 3-Jacek Zielinski, 4-Pawel Wojtala, 5-Tomasz Waldoch, 6-Marek Citko, 7-Piotr Swierczewski, 8-Henryk Baluszynski, 9-Andrzej Juskowiak, 10-Piotr Nowak, 11-Adam Ledwon

Italy: 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 2-Ciro Ferrara, 3-Paolo Maldini, 4-Dino Baggio, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 8-Diego Fuser, 9-Christian Vieri, 10-Roberto di Matteo, 11-Gianfranco Zola.
